operating_notes.text: Consolidated net worth ₹28,148.7 Cr and gross debt ₹79,989.2 Cr at March 31, 2026; debt-equity 2.84x per Annexure 1.
Secured listed NCDs outstanding ₹26,505.03 Cr and unsecured listed NCDs ₹127.89 Cr at March 31, 2026, with asset cover above 100%.
Deferred tax assets recognised at ₹2,812.10 Cr as on March 31, 2026 versus ₹2,715.84 Cr a year earlier.
Q4FY26 retail disbursements ₹13,101 Cr (+34% YoY); Wholesale 2.0 disbursements ₹2,782 Cr (+63% YoY) with repayments of ₹2,268 Cr.
Average borrowing cost 8.84% in Q4FY26, down 29 bps YoY; retail disbursement yields stable at 14.2%.
Cumulative assessed tax losses ~₹24,600 Cr after adding ₹10,110 Cr in Q4FY26.
Standalone total assets ₹1,09,542.43 Cr and PAT ₹1,540.02 Cr for FY26 per the NCLAT order.
Retail AUM yield 13.6% and 90+ DPD 0.7%, stable over four years.
Wholesale portfolio EIR 14.2%; repayments of ₹1,932 Cr were 74% of Q1FY27 disbursements, with pre-payments of ₹1,030 Cr.
Since Q2FY22 the company has disbursed ₹28,113 Cr across 419 wholesale loans and received ₹14,841 Cr of repayments.
Q2FY27 impairment allowances were ₹235.38 Cr, down from ₹273.59 Cr in Q1FY27.
QIP proceeds of ₹2,099.99 Cr were fully utilised for onward lending and general corporate purposes by Sep-2026.
Q2FY27 retail disbursement yields stable at 14.2%; wholesale EIR 14.1% with average ticket size ₹55 Cr.
Q2FY27 cost of borrowing stable QoQ at 8.79%; incremental long-term debt cost 8.46% in H1FY27 vs 8.67% in H2FY26.
Q2FY27 wholesale repayments of ₹1,889 Cr were 72% of disbursements.

timeline.summary: Piramal Finance Limited will host a conference call on **27 Apr 2026 at 5:00 PM (IST)** to discuss Q4 & FY2026 results, with dial-in details provided for India, USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,424.01 Cr, net profit ₹501.77 Cr.
2026-04-27: Q4FY26/FY26 results (consolidated): PAT ₹1,506 Cr for FY26 (+210% YoY) and ₹502 Cr for Q4FY26, AUM ₹1,01,230 Cr (+25% YoY), GNPA 2.3%.
Piramal Finance Limited hosted an earnings conference call on 27 April 2026, sharing audited standalone and consolidated results for Q4FY26 and FY26.

Piramal Finance Limited’s Bipin Singh confirms participation in Macquarie Asia Conference 2026 (18–19 May 2026, Hong Kong) and Citi’s 2026 Pan-Asia Conference (20 May 2026, Singapore) under SEBI Listing Regulations.
On April 30, 2026, the NCLT Mumbai Bench allowed Piramal Finance's scheme application to amalgamate three wholly owned subsidiaries.

2026-05-26: NCLAT allowed Piramal Finance's appeal and dispensed with the equity shareholders' meeting for the amalgamation of three wholly owned subsidiaries, directing creditor-style notices to shareholders instead.
Piramal Finance Limited’s 42nd AGM scheduled for July 2, 2026, via video conferencing; Record Date for final dividend of ₹11 per share set for June 12, 2026, signed by Bipin Singh.
Piramal Finance published an investor presentation for the Tokyo Roadshow on October 14, 2026.
Piramal Finance Limited’s **Bipin Singh** revised the **Q2 & H1 FY2027 earnings conference call** from 5:00 PM IST to **4:45 PM IST on 19th October 2026** while keeping other details unchanged.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,659.19 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹538.59 Cr.
Piramal Finance reported Q2FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹545 Cr, up 67% YoY, on AUM of ₹1,13,112 Cr (+24%), and completed a ₹3,850 Cr equity raise.
Piramal Finance Limited hosted a conference call on unaudited Q2 & H1FY27 results (ended 30-Sep-2026) with audio available via its website.
